recipe.visualDefinition: A surreal illustrative composition featuring a group of four men sitting inside a giant denim pocket. The style is characterized by 1970s-era commercial illustration with saturated colors, soft airbrushed shadows, and a flat, vibrant blue background. The central figures are rendered with realistic proportions but placed in a whimsical, oversized object context.
coreVisualRelationships: The giant denim pocket acts as a vessel for the human subjects.
The arched primary text frames the heads of the subjects like a halo.
The secondary text at the top provides a horizontal anchor against the curved elements.
The subjects' colorful clothing (orange, red, blue, purple) contrasts sharply against the monochromatic blue background.
coreInvariants: A single, large denim pocket with visible double-stitching.
A flat, solid blue background that matches the denim hue.
Subjects appearing to sit on the edge of the pocket opening.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subjects are centered horizontally, scaled down to fit within the width of a single pocket that occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark blue denim pocket serves as the heavy visual base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the arched yellow text, moves down to the faces of the subjects, and follows their legs into the depth of the pocket.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper corners and around the pocket to emphasize the central surreal concept.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue background and denim texture.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tones (orange, red, brown) in the subjects' clothing to create a focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout; the blue is deep and vibrant while the yellow is luminous.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and clean sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text follows a perfect circular arc.
Secondary text is perfectly horizontal and tracked out.
Primary text uses thick, rounded slab serifs with high weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the arched text is rotated to align with the radial path.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy decorative display font paired with a neutral, wide-tracked functional sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded 70s slab serif feel.
Provides the clean, neutral contrast for the top header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A gouache-style illustration of a giant blue denim pocket with visible white double-stitching, set against a solid cobalt blue background. Four men in 1970s fashion (orange, red, and blue shirts) are sitting on the edge of the pocket, looking forward and smiling. The lighting is soft and even with airbrushed shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a bright yellow, heavy slab-serif font, arched in a semi-circle above the men's heads. Add the secondary artist name in a white, clean sans-serif font at the very top, centered and horizontally straight.

verificationChecks: Is the pocket clearly denim with stitching?
Is the background a solid blue?
Are the subjects' clothes colorful and 70s-styled?

adjustableVariables: Arc degree of the primary text
Specific colors of the subjects' clothing
mustRedesign: Avoid literal transcription of original artist names
Do not include the specific record label logo in the corner
Ensure the illustration style is painterly, not a photograph
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text arc is symmetrical.
Ensure the subjects appear to be physically 'in' the pocket.
Verify the yellow text is legible against the blue background.
Confirm the stitching on the pocket is visible and detailed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surreal Scale + 70s Gouache Illustration + Arched Slab-Serif Typography + Monochromatic Background
